data.body:
OBE / already-satisfied — closing as duplicate of unhelping-creviced-rhino (e127-a3ad-895a-4a2f).

The guard this ticket asks for was delivered by rhino's Gerrit change 2358 (3642db3b9b21 "Guard
CLI JSON dumps and finish js-safe sweep", plus hardening in ba7a6bd3a0 "Harden CLI json js-safe
guard on advisory review"), now merged to origin/main. Verified on a fresh worktree at
origin/main (3bde5613718c):

AC vs. evidence
- scripts/check_cli_json_js_safe.py exists and is wired into make lint (Makefile:286; test
  test_make_lint_invokes_the_gate pins the wiring). make lint runs green on the clean tree.
- Negative control (teeth): seeded a BRAND-NEW CLI module src/rebar/_cli/_scratch_teeth_probe.py
  emitting print(json.dumps({"measured_at": time.time_ns()})) — the exact never-ran failure
  class. Guard flagged it non-zero:
    src/rebar/_cli/_scratch_teeth_probe.py:5: writes store data to stdout through a RAW
    json.dumps: print(json.dumps(payload, indent=2))   (exit 1)
  Removed the probe → guard back to exit 0, working tree clean.
- Passes on clean tree (exit 0) — not tripping on everything.
- Command set is derived STRUCTURALLY, not from a hand-maintained name list: the guard
  recursively scans SCAN_ROOTS (src/rebar/_cli, _commands, _engine_support, signing.py), so a
  newly-registered command file enters scope the moment it exists — proven by the teeth probe
  above (a new file, no guard edit) and by test_each_stdout_dumps_shape_is_rejected.
- Deterministic + provider-neutral: pure stdlib AST, no network, no LLM, runs in make lint
  anywhere (project.portability satisfied).

30 guard self-tests pass (tests/unit/test_cli_json_js_safe_guard.py). No coverage gap found; no
new code required. Closing as duplicate of e127's guard work.
